messages:
Aisha Nguyen: morning async — CedarFlow renewal next Tue. Quick standup: 1) What I did: triaged webhook delivery failures, confirmed retries hitting our gateway and then model fallback to smaller variant. 2) Blocker: renewal exec wants SLA explanation; engineering help needed to reduce 95th p95 spikes. 3) Today: try a short-term routing tweak, gather logs, and prep notes for renewal call.

Morgan Lee: noted. Renewal date 2026-03-24 10am PT. Exec will join. Need an SLO blurb by EOD :clock3:.

Ben Park: can you paste the gateway logs + the model route? Also which customer route (cedarflow-prod-01)?

Aisha Nguyen: yep route is cedarflow-prod-01. logs (last 5 errors):
```
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z ERROR 503 handler.go:142 request_id=rx0a model=redwood-4b variant=fallback
2026-03-15T09:12:04Z WARN  batcher.go:88 latency=820ms seq=43
2026-03-15T09:13:01Z ERROR 503 handler.go:142 request_id=ry3b model=redwood-4b variant=fallback
```

Diego Ramos: looks like batcher latency spikes at ~800ms before the fallback. Can we reproduce with a synthetic load? Ben, I can spin a short load test but need a safe window.

Ben Park: give me a 30m window now, I'll route a replication traffic to a staging cedarflow route. Aisha, can you change the customer route to prefer redwood-4b-async variant temporarily? config snippet:
```
route: cedarflow-prod-01
fallback_policy: prefer_variant redwood-4b-async
```

Aisha Nguyen: doing it now. I'll monitor for 15m and report back. If p95 drops, we keep until renewal. :pray:

DeployBot: deploy-started cedarflow-routing-tweak by Ben Park (deploy-id: dpl_77654)

Morgan Lee: prioritize this — if p95 stays high we'll offer 10% credit and note the mitigation in the renewal slide.

Sasha Patel: tagging @Diego Ramos and @Ben Park — please add a one-paragraph root-cause hypothesis for the renewal call. Thanks!

Aisha Nguyen: update — after 12m p95 dropped from 760ms -> 220ms. No new 503s in last 6m. Monitoring continues. I'll prep the EOD summary.

Ben Park: confirmed on staging. I'll follow up with more telemetry later. Thx team.
